The Pistons defense flustered Jayson Tatum, Boston's shooting went cold, and they blew a big lead in Detroit. Here's my initial reaction

items.author: MrBuckBuck

images.alt: i'm going to set myself on fire

items.title: Pistons got back in the game with a barrage of Javonte Green threes. Now, it's Duncan Robinson with a triple avalanche in the fourth quarter.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
Pistons got back in the game with a barrage of Javonte Green threes. Now, it's Duncan Robinson with a triple avalanche in the fourth quarter.

Detroit is on an 18-0 run to take a 107-99 lead with 5:10 to play. A lot of threes and free throws against disconnected Boston defense.

items.title: Another 3 for Duncan Robinson, and the Pistons are up 107-99. Celtics call timeout. He has 14 points in the 4th, which the Pistons are winning 25-11

items.title: Big-time block by John Collins sandwiched around a pair of Duncan Robinson triples. DET back to within four with 7:34 to play.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
Big-time block by John Collins sandwiched around a pair of Duncan Robinson triples. DET back to within four with 7:34 to play.

BOS wants to get to around six minutes before bringing Jayson Tatum back. And under six before bringing in Paul George with four fouls. Joe Mazzulla may need to go early.

items.title: Back-to-back Duncan Robinson 3s, after he went to the line for 3 FTs before that, and the Pistons have again pulled within 4 at 99-95 with 7:34 left.
